paragraphs.en: {Narrator}: Henry is walking along the street holding the bank note in his hand. His coat is worn in several places. He sees a sign for a {tailor}'s shop.
paragraphs.cn: 旁白：亨利手里拿着钞票在街上走。他的外套有几处都磨破了。他看到一家裁缝店的招牌。

paragraphs.en: Henry: (entering the shop) I'd like to have a suit coat.
paragraphs.cn: 亨利：（走进商店）我想买一件西装上装。

paragraphs.en: 1st {Clerk}: (in a rude {manner}) See him there. (pointing to another {clerk})
paragraphs.cn: 店员甲：（态度粗鲁地）找他。（指着另一个店员）

paragraphs.en: 2nd {Clerk}: Ready-made suits {downstairs}.
paragraphs.cn: 店员乙：成衣在楼下。

paragraphs.en: Henry: (after going down some stairs) Can you show me a suit, please?
paragraphs.cn: 亨利：（下了几级楼梯后）请问，能给我拿件衣服看看吗？

paragraphs.en: 3rd {Clerk}: Yes, I can, sir. This way, please. Ah, here we are, the very thing you need.
paragraphs.cn: 店员丙：好的，先生。这边请。啊，这就是您要的，正合适。

paragraphs.en: 1st {Clerk}: (pulling the 3rd {clerk} {aside} and whispering) Mr Reid says you'd better serve him quick and get him out quick!
paragraphs.cn: 店员甲：（把店员丙拉到一边，低声说）里德先生说，你最好快点招待他，然后快点把他打发走！

paragraphs.en: 3rd {Clerk}: I know what I'm doing. I've got eyes, haven't I?
paragraphs.cn: 店员丙：我知道我在做什么。我又不是没长眼睛，不是吗？

paragraphs.en: Henry: It's a little too bright, isn't it?
paragraphs.cn: 亨利：有点太亮了，不是吗？

paragraphs.en: 3rd {Clerk}: (looking at him with a {frown}) It's all we have in your size.
paragraphs.cn: 店员丙：（皱着眉头看着他）这是您这种尺码我们仅有的了。

paragraphs.en: Henry: Well, I suppose it ought to do for now. I'll take it.
paragraphs.cn: 亨利：嗯，我想现在凑合一下也行。我买了。

paragraphs.en: 3rd {Clerk}: Good. Shall I put it in a box?
paragraphs.cn: 店员丙：好。要装在盒子里吗？

paragraphs.en: Henry: No. I'll wear it. Oh, I'd rather not pay you now. I'd like to pay in a month. You see, I don't have any small change.
paragraphs.cn: 亨利：不用。我穿着。哦，我宁愿现在不付钱。我想一个月后付款。你看，我身上没带零钱。

paragraphs.en: 3rd {Clerk}: (trying not to show he's angry) I suppose a gentleman like you only carries very large bills.
paragraphs.cn: 店员丙：（尽量不显出恼怒）我想，像您这样的绅士只带大票子。

paragraphs.en: Henry: Now, you shouldn't {judge} people by their clothes. I just don't want to cause you trouble with a large note.
paragraphs.cn: 亨利：你不该以衣取人。我只是不想拿张大票子给你添麻烦。

paragraphs.en: 3rd {Clerk}: It's no trouble at all.
paragraphs.cn: 店员丙：一点都不麻烦。

paragraphs.en: Henry: In that case, there's no problem. (He gives the {clerk} the bank note. The {clerk} drops Henry's coat. Then he folds the bill and slowly unfolds it again, as if looking at something he can't believe is there.)
paragraphs.cn: 亨利：那样的话，就没问题了。（他把钞票递给店员。店员扔下亨利的外套。接着他把钞票折起来，又慢慢展开，好像在看一件他不敢相信摆在眼前的东西。）

paragraphs.en: Owner: Well, what seems to be the trouble?
paragraphs.cn: 店主：嗯，出了什么问题？

paragraphs.en: Henry: I'm just waiting for my change.
paragraphs.cn: 亨利：我只是在等找零。

paragraphs.en: Owner: Give him his change, Todd. Get going. (after getting the bank note from Todd) Would it ... could it be the one I saw in the papers last week? I remember thinking that never would I hold such a note as this ... (to Henry) Oh, take off this coat, sir. (to Todd) Go get the others, Todd! (to Henry again) Allow me, sir! This way, sir.
paragraphs.cn: 店主：给他找零，托德。快去。（从托德手里接过钞票）会不会……会不会是上周我在报上看到的那张？我记得当时想，我永远也拿不到这样一张钞票……（对亨利）哦，先生，把这件外套脱下来。（对托德）托德，去把其他的拿来！（又对亨利）先生，让我来。先生，这边请。

paragraphs.en: (in another part of the shop, where there is a wide range of options for Henry to choose from)
paragraphs.cn: （在商店的另一处，亨利有各种各样的选择）

paragraphs.en: Henry: This is nice, but I really don't need it.
paragraphs.cn: 亨利：这很好，但我真的不需要。

paragraphs.en: Owner: Never mind. (with a {broad} smile) Oh, it's perfect! It was made for some king but he'll just have to wait. You'll need many suits for many occasions. Yes, {indeed} you will.
paragraphs.cn: 店主：没关系。（满面笑容）哦，太完美了！这是为某位国王做的，但他只好等一等了。不同场合您得穿不同的套装。是的，您确实需要。

paragraphs.en: Henry: Wait a minute. I only came here to get a suit coat to wear today. I {dare} not buy all these things. You would have to wait a long time to get paid.
paragraphs.cn: 亨利：等一等。我今天来这里只是想买件今天穿的西装上装。我可不敢买所有这些东西。你得等很久才能拿到钱。

paragraphs.en: Owner: A long time, sir? Why, you don't have to worry about that!
paragraphs.cn: 店主：很久吗，先生？哎呀，您不必为此担心！

paragraphs.en: Henry: Well, all right. I'll take the suit coat for now and get the others later.
paragraphs.cn: 亨利：嗯，那好吧。我现在先买这件上装，其他的以后再来买。

paragraphs.en: Owner: Fine, fine. Your address, sir?
paragraphs.cn: 店主：好，好。先生，您的地址？

paragraphs.en: Henry: I don't have one. Er ... I'm moving.
paragraphs.cn: 亨利：我没有地址。呃……我要搬家了。

paragraphs.en: Owner: Of course you are! That's very {normal}! A busy man, I'm sure.
paragraphs.cn: 店主：您当然要搬！那很正常！我看您一定是个大忙人。
